skills.name: Strike Down
skills.description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 30% chance of placing a 25% [Weaken] debuff for 2 turns.

skills.name: Higher Blessing
skills.description: Attacks all enemies. Places a 25% [Increase ATK] buff on all allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Dark Bolt
skills.description: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 40% chance of placing a 2.5% [Poison] debuff for 2 turns.

skills.name: Acid Rain
skills.description: Attacks all enemies. Has a 40% chance of placing a 2.5% [Poison] debuff for 2 turns.

skills.name: Disintegrate
skills.description: Attacks 1 enemy 4 times. Each hit has a 75% chance of placing a 5% [Poison] debuff for 2 turns.
